# MyLotus

> MyLotus is an iPhone app that writes one personalized quote, proverb or affirmation every morning, based on a profile written by the user's own AI assistant (Claude or ChatGPT).

MyLotus ("MyLotus: Personalized Quotes" on the App Store) is published by Isaac Cohen in Paris, France. Contact: contact@my-lotus.app.

Key facts:
- Personalization: the app gives the user a prompt to paste into Claude, ChatGPT or another AI assistant. The assistant writes a short profile from what it already knows; the user pastes it back, and every phrase is written from that profile. A one-minute questionnaire is available for users without an AI assistant.
- Each phrase comes with its author and the reason it was chosen for the user.
- Features: daily personalized phrase, Instagram share cards, wallpapers, Couple pack (one mirror phrase for two).
- Pricing: MyLotus Premium, $29.99 per year with a 7-day free trial, or $4.99 per month. Billed and managed by Apple.
- Platform: iOS (iPhone). Languages: English and French.
- Privacy: no ads, data never sold, account and data deletable in Settings. Profiles are sent to an AI model only with explicit consent.
- Before the app, more than 11,000 people tried MyLotus phrases by message and email.
